items.summary: Financial recommendation: continue only the six existing bounded workstreams; approve no expansion, spending, monetization changes, or new queue actions this cycle. Revenue claims are unsupported at site level: Amazon reports $4.92 commission, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items for 2026-09-21, but all income is in an aggregate unattributed row. Site-attributed income is $0. Contribution margin, ROI, CAC, payback, profitability, and forecasts are not calculable because direct non-AI costs, fixed infrastructure costs, labor allocation, and site-level revenue attribution are unavailable. AI usage is measurable: $759.78 from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-23 across 4,529 calls, with 207 errors; this is an observability cost, not proof of productive return. The known AI spend is 154.43x the single-day aggregate commission, but that comparison is not a valid period-matched ROI or margin calculation. Budget exposure is also incomplete because monthly spend, fixed-cost, marketing-budget, and revenue-floor fields are blank; Codex Pro is fixed subscription but its dollar cost is not supplied. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because experiment-level incremental spend and measured outcomes are absent. Minimum measurement before any financial expansion: a period-matched ledger of site/content-level revenue, shipped commission, AI/infrastructure/direct costs, and experiment exposures with baseline and post-change outcomes. Treat 13,383 impressions, 129 clicks, 947 sessions, and 15 conversions as activity metrics only; zero outcomes are proven and three improvements await measurement. Keep SearchWoot private and do not claim monetization value while attribution and launch gates remain incomplete.

CFO decision request: provide or authorize a read-only, period-matched cost ledger covering AI, infrastructure, domains, and other direct operating costs, plus site-level revenue attribution. Without these inputs, contribution margin, cost-to-learn, budget exposure, and forecasts remain non-calculable. No money movement, billing change, banking access, contract, or production monetization change is requested.
